caption: Region growing from seed (0,0)=5 with 4-connectivity and |f−5|≤1: the ten shaded pixels pass the test, while every 3 and every 9 fails, so the region stops there.

spec.title: Region growing from a seed: 10 pixels accepted
spec.aria: A 4 by 4 grid of grey values; the seed at (0,0) and the nine other accepted pixels are shaded, giving a region of 10 pixels, while the three 3s in the bottom row and the three 9s in the right column are greyed out because they fail the predicate absolute f minus 5 less than or equal to 1.
